documents.title: Annual report extract
documents.text:
Annual report extract: Kalvik Software (fictional, authored test material).
Recurring revenue share at Kalvik Software stood at 80.5% with effect from 1 Jan 2025. Kalvik Software had gross debt of $237.3m in FY2025 (reported basis). For Kalvik Software, senior leverage in FY2024 was 2.09x (pro forma (including the planned acquisition) basis). Cash on balance sheet at Kalvik Software stood at $53.7m in FY2024 (reported basis).

documents.title: Quarterly lender update
documents.text:
Quarterly lender update: Kalvik Software (fictional, authored test material).
Operating expenses at Kalvik Software stood at around $203m in FY2025 (reported basis). Kalvik Software had recurring revenue share of 58.7% with effect from 1 Jul 2025. For Kalvik Software, gross debt in FY2025 was $187.4m (reported basis). Debt service cover ratio at Kalvik Software stood at 1.38x in FY2024. The change of control definition for Kalvik Software is understood as follows: triggered by any transfer of more than 30% of economic interest.

For Kalvik Software, cash on balance sheet was $67.4m (reported basis). Debt service cover ratio of Kalvik Software in FY2024: to be confirmed; not included in this document.
